name: Coloring & Pie with Wide Tim
description: A two-part Artfinity series: a week and a half of coloring with Wide Tim, wrapped up with pie on Pi Day.
imageAlt: Kids coloring a window mural of Wide Tim

name: MIT Campus Preview Weekend
description: MIT's four-day celebration for admitted students, with over 700 events for about 1,000 visitors each April — Wide Tim first went wide at the virtual CPW in 2021 and has been part of it every year since 2022.
imageAlt: Wide Tim cutout in front of a CPW backdrop covered in Wide Tim faces

name: Wide Tim at the COOP
description: Wide Tim merch, including t-shirts, has been on sale at the MIT COOP since late 2024.
imageAlt: A rack of green Wide Tim t-shirts at the MIT COOP under a sign reading "@Wide_Tim is at the COOP!"

name: MathPrize for Girls
description: A math competition for high school girls held at MIT. Wide Tim was part of it every fall from 2022 to 2025, down to the registration signs.
imageAlt: A MathPrize for Girls registration sign featuring Wide Tim, on an easel

name: MIT Infinite Possibilities
description: Featured a Wide Tim cutout and exhibition at the Marriott Hotel.
imageAlt: Wide Tim cutout beside a screen showing Wide Tim sailing, at the Marriott Hotel

name: Lunch Break with Wide Tim
description: An outdoor lunchtime pop-up with MIT Open Space Programming, with Wide Tim art up on the big screen.
imageAlt: An MIT Open Space Programming table covered in colorful blocks on a lawn, with Wide Tim art on a large outdoor screen behind it

name: The Beaver with the Infinite Smile
description: Margaret's first-person essay for MIT Technology Review's March/April 2023 issue, on how Wide Tim grew from a welcome post for the Class of 2024 into a campus-wide character.
imageAlt: Margaret Zheng holding a small Wide Tim in front of a wall of Wide Tim art
